notes: three chains: the second («وحدثني ابن سلام») and the third («وعن عمارة») follow the first with no «ح»; the third opens with a bare «وعن», so whether it is a further route of this saying is not settled
«وكانت سبية منهم عند عائشة» and the second saying «فقال أعتقيها» have no isnad of their own, so they are not routes
«زاد» / «ما زلت أحب ... منذ ثلاث» are wording differences, not transmitters
